evidence: Updates src/rpc/util.cpp and src/rpc/request.cpp to add structured error data support to JSONRPCError, and modifies getrawtransaction and gettxoutproof behavior.
rationale: Extends JSON-RPC error handling to return structured candidate block hashes in error.data and modifies getrawtransaction verbosity 2 to gracefully omit unavailable undo data. This provides structured feedback allowing callers to fetch missing pruned blocks via getblockfrompeer.
